commit_message: Complete ADR0126 shared Timeline authoring service
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the shared transactional Timeline authoring mutations required by Sequencer and external authoring surfaces: duration, track/clip rename, typed clip payload replacement, and marker-event edits. These operations stay inside TimelineAuthoringService so GUI, CLI, and MCP do not diverge.

The PR remains Draft while runtime contract hardening, Project Rust control, Sequencer, and final validation continue.
